jobs.title: Join our expanding ERP Advisory Team - Implementation Lead - Accounting Solutions (Remote)
General Manager - Military/VA Health (Business Development, Oracle Health Implementations)
jobs.description:
Description:  



**About S\&P**


S\&P Consultants is a veteran\-owned small business that helps federal, state, local, tribal, and rural healthcare organizations navigate complex technology change. We bring deep healthcare expertise and large\-scale transformation experience to the work that matters most—helping clients move critical initiatives forward with clarity, practical leadership, and a focus on lasting results. Our size gives us the agility to adapt, make thoughtful decisions, and act on strong ideas, while our experience enables us to take on complex, high\-impact challenges. Everything we do is grounded in integrity, genuine commitment to our people, exceptional customer value, and transparent communication. These values shape how we work with clients, partners, and one another—and how we are building what comes next.


Learn more at www.spfed.com.

  



**About the Role**


S\&P Consultants has spent nearly three decades helping healthcare organizations navigate complex technology change. Our strength comes from pairing deep healthcare and Oracle Health expertise with experienced people who bring clarity, accountability, and practical leadership to large\-scale transformations. Today, S\&P supports several of the nation’s most consequential federal EHR modernization efforts, creating a strong foundation for continued growth across the Military Health System and Department of Veterans Affairs.


We are seeking a General Manager, Military Health \& Veterans Affairs, to build on that foundation and lead S\&P’s growth in these priority markets. Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer and serving on the growth leadership team, this leader will own the portfolio strategy and performance for Military Health and VA, working with the other General Managers and the Head of Capture to advance S\&P’s enterprise growth priorities.


S\&P has established a strong position supporting large\-scale Oracle Health modernization efforts, including a large\-scale Oracle Health implementation as part of the VA Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) program. The General Manager will deepen that position while pursuing complementary opportunities across clinical informatics, interoperability, testing, data, revenue cycle, digital health, and operational transformation.


This role extends beyond generating pipeline or managing individual pursuits. The General Manager will understand where Military Health and VA customers are headed, connect their most important challenges with S\&P’s strengths, and turn that insight into focused strategies, practical offerings, strong partnerships, and sustained growth.


Working within the direction set by the Chief Growth Officer, the General Manager will translate enterprise strategy into a clear portfolio plan, build trusted customer and partner relationships, and make disciplined recommendations about where S\&P should lead, partner, invest, or decline to pursue.


For an accomplished federal healthcare growth leader, S\&P offers the credibility of an established healthcare technology company, the agility of a growing veteran\-owned small business, and meaningful room to shape a priority portfolio. Success will mean strengthening S\&P’s position in Military Health and VA, winning the right work, and building a business that delivers lasting customer value.

  



**Key Responsibilities**

**Market Strategy \& Growth Leadership**

* Develop and execute a multi\-year growth strategy for Military Health and Veterans Affairs, with clear priorities for customers, markets, services, revenue, pipeline, market access, partnerships, and investment.
* Maintain a deep understanding of Military Health and VA priorities, funding, modernization initiatives, acquisition strategies, and competitive dynamics.
* Develop and maintain strategic account plans for priority Military Health and VA customers, informed by their mission priorities, operational needs, funding, acquisition timelines, and competitive dynamics.
* Translate S\&P's capabilities, past performance, relationships, and delivery experience into differentiated approaches to important customer challenges and practical paths to new programs and customers.
* Represent S\&P in senior customer engagements, industry associations, conferences, partner forums, and thought leadership activities.
* Advise the Chief Growth Officer and executive leadership team on the opportunities, risks, capabilities, and investments needed to strengthen the portfolio.

**Business Development, Capture \& Partnerships**

* Build trusted\-advisor relationships with senior federal healthcare decision\-makers, prime contractors, technology vendors, and other strategic partners to understand priorities, shape opportunities, and strengthen S\&P's market position.
* Identify, qualify, and advance opportunities that align with S\&P’s strategy, capabilities, and customer needs.
* Guide early opportunity strategy, including solution direction, customer engagement, competitive positioning, win themes, and partner approach.
* Develop teaming and partnership strategies that expand access to contract vehicles, priority programs, complementary capabilities, and sustainable workshare.
* Partner with the Head of Capture to bring market context, customer insight, competitive intelligence, and partner strategy into priority pursuits.

**Service Line Development \& Market Expansion**

* Identify evolving customer needs and determine where S\&P can credibly expand its Military Health and VA portfolio.
* Recommend the services, capabilities, partnerships, and investments S\&P needs to pursue those opportunities successfully.
* Work with Service Delivery to develop practical offerings that solve important customer problems and can be delivered consistently.
* Help bring new offerings to market and expand S\&P’s impact on existing programs without compromising delivery quality or customer trust.

**Revenue \& Performance Accountability**

* Own bookings, revenue, pipeline, and market expansion objectives for the Military Health and Veterans Affairs portfolio.
* Monitor opportunity progression, pipeline quality, forecasts, win rates, and overall business performance, and report clearly to executive leadership.
* Support annual planning, budgeting, and investment decisions that balance near\-term performance with sustained portfolio growth.
* Protect and expand S\&P's position on existing programs by anticipating retention risks, planning for recompetes, and pursuing organic growth that supports successful execution and sustained customer value.


Requirements:
* 10\+ years of senior\-level growth leadership, business development, and/or capture experience in the federal market, including significant experience in Military Health and Veterans Affairs.
* Experience growing technology consulting, health IT modernization, implementation, optimization, or related professional services; Oracle Health knowledge is strongly preferred.
* A demonstrated record of originating and winning complex opportunities, expanding market position, and producing measurable revenue growth.
* Experience using customer and market insight to shape new offerings and build sustainable growth beyond individual pursuits.
* Established credibility and relationships across Military Health, Veterans Affairs, prime contractors, technology partners, and the broader federal healthcare ecosystem.
* Strong executive presence, sound judgment, alignment with S\&P's core values, and the ability to influence customers, partners, and internal leaders.
* U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a government clearance when required for client engagements.

**Additional Details**

* This is a remote position.
* Travel is estimated at 25–50% to engage with customers, partners, and internal teams. Proximity to the Washington, DC, metropolitan area is a plus.
* The projected annual salary range is $190,000–$240,000, with the possibility of performance\-based incentives. Actual compensation will reflect the candidate's education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract affordability and organizational requirements. This range is an estimate and does not guarantee compensation.
* S\&P's total compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; a 401(k); paid holidays; and paid time off.
* This posting will remain open for 120 days or until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Head of Service Delivery (Oracle Health Implementation Leadership)
jobs.description:
Description:  



**About S\&P**


S\&P Consultants is a veteran\-owned small business that helps federal, state, local, tribal, and rural healthcare organizations navigate complex technology change. We bring deep healthcare expertise and large\-scale transformation experience to the work that matters most—helping clients move critical initiatives forward with clarity, practical leadership, and a focus on lasting results. Our size gives us the agility to adapt, make thoughtful decisions, and act on strong ideas, while our experience enables us to take on complex, high\-impact challenges. Everything we do is grounded in integrity, genuine commitment to our people, exceptional customer value, and transparent communication. These values shape how we work with clients, partners, and one another—and how we are building what comes next. Learn more at www.spfed.com.

**About the Role**


S\&P Consultants has spent nearly three decades helping healthcare organizations navigate complex technology change. Our strength comes from pairing deep healthcare and Oracle Health expertise with experienced consultants who bring clarity, accountability, and practical leadership to complex transformations. Today, S\&P supports several of the nation’s most consequential federal EHR modernization efforts, alongside a growing portfolio of state, local, tribal, and rural healthcare work.


We are seeking a Head of Service Delivery who can build on this foundation and shape how S\&P delivers as the company grows. Reporting to the President and serving as a senior leader across the company, this role will lead the consulting organization and be accountable for performance across S\&P’s portfolio of complex healthcare technology programs—including delivery quality, schedules, staffing, financial results, risk, compliance, client satisfaction, and the development and engagement of S\&P’s teams.


As S\&P takes on more major initiatives, the Head of Service Delivery will build a scalable, repeatable model for program leadership and project execution—one that gives leaders clear accountability, provides reliable visibility into performance, and enables teams to respond proactively. This leader will develop capable managers, help consultants grow, and ensure the organization is ready to meet current commitments and future opportunities. The goal is disciplined, dependable delivery without losing the responsiveness, agility, and experienced judgment that distinguish S\&P.


Healthcare transformation will remain central to S\&P’s work. The company has established a strong position supporting large\-scale Oracle Health modernization, with experience spanning implementation and optimization, clinical informatics, interoperability, testing, data, revenue cycle, digital health, training, go\-live, stabilization, and sustainment. The Head of Service Delivery will keep programs grounded in the realities behind the plan—connecting technology decisions to clinical and operational work, preparing clients and users for adoption, and ensuring that progress is demonstrated through readiness and results.


This is not a role focused only on overseeing projects or stepping in when delivery problems arise. It is an opportunity to build the leadership, operating discipline, and financial accountability required to run several major initiatives concurrently while remaining close enough to clients and teams to understand what is changing and what support is needed. That proximity will also allow the Head of Service Delivery to shape new pursuits, identify opportunities within existing programs, and help determine the capabilities the company should build next.


For an accomplished delivery leader, S\&P offers a compelling combination: complex, mission\-critical work; the credibility and expertise of an established healthcare technology company; and the agility of a growing veteran\-owned small business. Success will mean developing strong leaders, earning the confidence of customers and partners, achieving consistent operational and financial results, and building a delivery organization that consultants are proud to be part of and that S\&P can confidently scale as we grow.

  



**Key Responsibilities**

**Delivery Performance \& Operating Model**

* Own end\-to\-end service delivery performance across all company engagements, including scope, schedules, quality, resourcing, financial performance, and risk.
* Build and lead a scalable service delivery operating model—including clear roles, accountability, governance, escalation paths, consistent delivery practices, and a regular cadence for reporting and trend review—that produces consistent outcomes across multiple programs and can expand as S\&P’s portfolio grows.
* Own the definition, implementation, and ongoing management of delivery KPIs, including but not limited to: timeline and milestone adherence; budget, revenue, and margin performance; program quality and risk measures; client and partner satisfaction and retention; and resource utilization and engagement.
* Ensure every engagement meets or exceeds performance targets, contractual commitments, governmental requirements, and applicable Service Level Agreements.
* Serve as S\&P’s senior delivery representative with federal, state, local, tribal, and rural healthcare customers, technology vendors, system integrators, prime contractors, and other partners—building trusted relationships, aligning expectations, and resolving issues to support successful delivery.

**Consulting Team Leadership \& Talent Development**

* Lead and develop service delivery leaders, program and project managers, functional and technical leads, consultants, and subject matter experts. Build capable managers who set clear expectations, coach and engage their teams, remove obstacles, secure resources, recognize strong contributions, and redirect or escalate when needed.
* Create a collaborative, accountable consulting culture in which teams raise concerns early, work across disciplines to deliver high\-quality, integrated solutions, and stay focused on the client’s real needs.
* Build leadership depth and maintain a portfolio\-wide understanding of consultants’ capabilities, experience, interests, and development goals. Work through delivery managers to provide coaching, cross\-training, and assignment opportunities that support employees’ growth, meet changing program and client needs, transition employees as contracts evolve or end, and prepare S\&P for future opportunities.
* Ensure compliance with government/client labor category (LCAT) requirements, training, and certification standards.

**Financial \& Contract Performance**

* Be accountable for the financial performance of the consulting organization and its programs, including budgets, forecasts, burn rates, revenue, margin, funding levels, and resource utilization. Ensure staffing and delivery decisions support both client commitments and company objectives.
* Hold program leaders accountable for accurate, timely information on staffing, progress, forecasts, risks, and expected outcomes, and ensure emerging concerns are addressed early.
* Partner with Corporate Finance and the Contract Program Management Office to support accurate forecasting, invoicing, funding management, reporting, and compliance with FAR/DFARS, contract terms, and internal policies.
* Represent Service Delivery in contract negotiations, modifications, and performance reviews, ensuring decisions reflect delivery requirements, staffing implications, financial impact, and customer commitments.

**Growth Partnership \& Delivery Readiness**

* Partner with Growth leadership to align pipeline priorities with staffing, workforce planning, onboarding, and delivery readiness so S\&P can launch new work effectively.
* Shape the delivery approach and staffing strategy for priority pursuits, bringing relevant program experience and metrics into proposal development, client and partner discussions, oral presentations, and post\-award transition planning.
* Leverage firsthand insight into client priorities and program performance to shape opportunities for adjacent services, increased workshare, contract expansion, and follow\-on work, in partnership with Growth leadership.
* Identify the delivery capabilities S\&P needs for future opportunities, including the expertise, tools, and operating approaches required in areas such as data interoperability, cybersecurity, health analytics, training, clinical informatics, EHR sustainment, and other complementary healthcare and enterprise transformation services.

**What Success Looks Like in the First Year**

* Build a strong command of S\&P’s delivery portfolio, establish trusted relationships with customers, partners, and internal leaders, and identify the programs, risks, and decisions requiring immediate attention.
* Establish clear accountability across service delivery, with capable managers who understand their authority, actively lead their teams, and address delivery and performance issues early.
* Create a reliable operating rhythm for reviewing program health, financial performance, staffing, customer concerns, and enterprise risks—and turn that visibility into timely action.
* Establish effective partnerships with Growth, Finance, CPMO, People Operations, and IT to ensure new work is properly planned, staffed, launched, and supported.
* Establish a scalable, repeatable model for program leadership and project execution that enables S\&P to deliver multiple initiatives concurrently with consistent governance, visibility, quality, and accountability.


Requirements:
* 10\+ years of experience leading large, complex healthcare IT programs in a consulting or professional services company, with Oracle Health expertise strongly preferred.
* Proven success leading multi\-task\-order portfolios and large\-scale implementations, as well as overseeing several major initiatives concurrently. Experience with government healthcare modernization programs is ideal.
* Proven experience building and scaling large consulting teams, including leading managers and other senior leaders responsible for program and project execution.
* Demonstrated ability to establish consistent governance, performance measures, and operating practices across multiple programs while remaining close enough to delivery to identify risks, support leaders, and intervene when needed.
* Strong financial and business judgment, with experience managing P\&L, budgets, forecasts, utilization, funding, revenue, and margin for large consulting departments and programs.
* Demonstrated ability to use operating and financial data to guide decisions, provide clear reporting that supports timely action, and communicate effectively with clients, partners, managers, and senior leaders.
* Strong understanding of federal acquisition and delivery environments, including FAR/DFARS requirements and task order management, is strongly preferred.
* A client\-first leadership approach that combines disciplined execution with sound judgment and keeps delivery focused on practical outcomes.
* U.S. citizenship with the ability to obtain the required federal clearance.

**Additional Details**

* This is a remote position. Travel is estimated at 25–50% to engage with customers, partners, and internal teams.
* The projected annual salary range is $200,000–$250,000\. Actual compensation will reflect the candidate’s education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract\-specific affordability and organizational requirements. This range is an estimate and does not guarantee compensation.
* S\&P’s total compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; a 401(k); paid holidays; and paid time off.
* This posting will remain open for 120 days or until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Clinical Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Clinical Implementation Specialist**

Account Engagement – I/O Urology Diagnostics Inc (CarePath)

**About I/O Urology**

I/O Urology is dedicated to enhancing the lives of those living with urologic conditions by providing a convenient, accessible, and stress\-free way to monitor their health from the comfort of home. Through our CarePath device, patients gather accurate, reliable data without frequent clinic visits, giving patients and providers immediate access to insights that enhance diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing care.

**Position Summary**

The Clinical Implementation Specialist is the hands\-on partner for clinics adopting the CarePath System. This role ensures that CarePath becomes fully embedded in the clinic’s Lower Urinary Tract Symptom (LUTS) care pathway — that ordering a CarePath Evaluation becomes a routine, reliable step in how the practice works up and manages LUTS patients, and that the resulting reports are consistently retrieved, reviewed, and acted on.

You will work closely with physicians, Advanced Practice Providers (APPs), and clinic operations teams to design, implement, and optimize CarePath workflows — from ordering and receiving CarePath Evaluations to provider review and action planning. This role bridges the clinical and operational sides of healthcare delivery, helping practices efficiently adopt CarePath, improve patient engagement, and deliver better care outcomes through better use of data. Internally, you will collaborate with I/O Urology’s IT, Patient Support, Sales, and Marketing teams to create clarity in the delivery of information through the CarePath Evaluation.

New account onboarding is the center of gravity for this role. Once Sales has established the value of CarePath with the initial ordering providers at an account, you own the transition from interest to routine use CarePath is designed to be simple to implement ; success in this role comes from knowing how a urology clinic operates and being the person every clinic stakeholder—is comfortable working with.

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Account Onboarding**

* Own the handoff from Sales at newly signed accounts and drive the account from initial provider interest to routine, self\-sufficient use of CarePath.
* Onboard the account Administrator to establish and configure I/O Urology portal access
* Train ordering staff to place complete CarePath orders and to retrieve and route CarePath Evaluation reports from the portal.
* Work with the practice and its IT resources to build CarePath into the way orders are already placed in the EMR, including order sets, so that ordering CarePath requires no new habit. Understand how the clinic utilizes its systems to share workflow information between providers and staff.
* Confirm that each new account can independently complete the full cycle — order placed, patient supported, report retrieved, report reviewed — before considering onboarding complete.
* Establish a named point of contact at the account and a clear escalation path back into I/O Urology.

**Clinical Adoption \& Workflow Integration**

* Partner with clinics to integrate CarePath seamlessly into their LUTS care pathways.
* Ensure smooth execution of CarePath processes: ordering, receiving, reviewing, and applying evaluation report insights.
* Coordinate with clinic scheduling staff so that patient appointments align with CarePath evaluation timelines and reports are available when the patient is next seen.
* Train staff on what constitutes a complete and valid order from the treating provider, so that evaluations can be performed without avoidable rework or delay.
* Identify and resolve friction in the CarePath workflow — incomplete orders, reports not reaching the ordering provider, portal access gaps — and re\-train as needed.
* Understand the key players within a clinic’s team – those who often drive activity beyond their title – and leverage their help for CarePath integration into the LUTS care pathways.

**Provider Engagement \& Report Education**

* Be comfortable and credible in front of providers: able to walk a physician or APP through a CarePath Evaluation report and the insights the data reveals about their patient.
* Educate providers on interpreting CarePath data and translating it into their own clinical decision\-making. This education is one of the primary drivers of provider confidence in CarePath and of sustained use
* Bring recurring provider questions, points of confusion, and report\-interpretation themes back to the CMO, Marketing, and Product Development so materials, reports, and product can be improved.
* Coordinate closely with Sales, who own the commercial relationship and the case for CarePath. Your role is to make CarePath easy to use and easy to understand — not to sell it.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build trust\-based relationships across the clinic
* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for CarePath implementation questions at assigned accounts.
* Communicate clearly and adapt to the audience — the same workflow explanation lands differently with a physician, an office manager, and an IT administrator.

**Training \& Ongoing Support**

* Deliver training virtually, using portal walkthroughs and short, role\-specific sessions that fit into a clinic’s day.
* Maintain and improve role\-based training materials and quick\-reference guides for Administrators, ordering staff, and providers.
* Re\-train accounts after staff turnover, as requested, and proactively check in with accounts whose usage patterns suggest a workflow or access problem.
* Support onsite when an account genuinely requires it.

**Internal Collaboration**

* Partner with I/O Urology’s IT team on portal access, integration, and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate as necessary with Patient Support Services to ensure congruity between account and patient engagement.
* Provide Sales with a clear picture of implementation status and readiness at each account.
* Work with Marketing to create adoption tools, communication resources, and educational materials.

**Implementation Quality \& Continuous Improvement**

* Track the operational health of assigned accounts — order completeness, portal proficiency, report retrieval, and time from order to report review — and act on what the data shows.
* Identify and remove barriers within the CarePath workflow itself; escalate recurring or systemic issues internally rather than working around them account by account.
* Contribute to standardizing the implementation playbook so that onboarding is consistent and repeatable across accounts and specialists.
* Document implementation activity and account status accurately and in accordance with I/O Urology policy.

**Qualifications**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in nursing, healthcare administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent clinical or clinic\-operations experience considered.
* 3–5\+ years of experience in clinic workflow, clinical implementation, care coordination, practice operations, or
* Strongly preferred: direct experience in a urology clinic, or in another specialty clinic with comparable diagnostic ordering workflows. Experience with multiple EMRs
* Working knowledge of how orders are placed in an EMR, including order sets, and of who does what in a clinic between order and result.
* Comfort demonstrating and teaching a web\-based portal to non\-technical users.
* Experience interacting directly with physicians and APPs in a clinical or implementation capacity.
* Familiarity with HIPAA requirements and handling of protected health information.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* **Clinic Workflow Fluency –** Skilled at navigating the real workflow of a busy clinic and identifying where a new step will and will not stick.
* **Interpersonal Range –** Builds rapport quickly and credibly across the full range of clinic stakeholders, from physician to medical assistant to IT.
* **Provider Credibility –** Confident and comfortable speaking with physicians and APPs about clinical data; able to share insight from a CarePath Evaluation without overstepping into clinical decision\-making.
* **Teaching Clarity –** Able to explain a workflow or portal function clearly to someone with limited available time and little interest in software.
* **Organization \& Follow\-Through –** Runs multiple account onboardings in parallel and follows each through to genuine self\-sufficiency.
* **Problem Solving –** Resourceful in diagnosing why a workflow isn’t working — access, training, timing, or ownership — and fixing the actual cause.
* **Remote Effectiveness –** Effective virtually: builds trust and delivers training over video and phone
* **Compliance Judgment –** Understands the boundary between supporting the correct use of a diagnostic service and supporting a practice’s business — and stays on the right side of it.

**Scope \& Compliance Boundaries**

I/O Urology Diagnostics is an Independent Diagnostic Testing Facility (IDTF). The Clinical Implementation Specialist supports the correct ordering, performance, and delivery of the CarePath Evaluation — and nothing beyond it. Specifically, this role:

* Supports workflow only as it relates to CarePath ordering, patient participation, and report retrieval and review; it does not provide general practice management, staffing, throughput, coding, billing, revenue, or marketing consulting to accounts.
* Does not solicit, initiate, modify, or influence the content of a treating provider’s order, and does not order tests on a provider’s behalf.
* Educates providers on the clinical content of CarePath Evaluation reports; it does not make or direct clinical decisions, and does not document in the practice’s medical record or perform the practice’s clinical or administrative work.
* Does not directly solicit patients, and does not offer anything of independent value to an account or its staff as an inducement to order.

All activity is conducted in accordance with I/O Urology’s compliance program, the federal Anti\-Kickback Statute, and applicable IDTF performance standards.

**Work Environment**

This is a predominantly virtual role. CarePath is designed to be straightforward to implement and explain, and most accounts can be fully onboarded and supported remotely. Expect up to 20% travel for accounts where onsite presence is genuinely warranted, along with occasional flexibility outside standard business hours to reach clinic staff and providers when their schedules allow.

**Performance Metrics**

* Time from account signature to first CarePath order placed, and to a fully onboarded account
* Onboarding completeness — Administrator trained, portal access configured, ordering staff trained, report retrieval verified
* Order completeness and accuracy at assigned accounts (rate of orders requiring rework)
* Time from report availability to provider review
* Account self\-sufficiency — reduction in basic access and how\-to support requests after onboarding
* Provider and staff feedback on training quality and responsiveness
* Quality and timeliness of implementation documentation and internal handoffs

**Why Join I/O Urology?**

* Be part of a company redefining the standard of urologic care.
* Help clinics harness the power of better data for better patient outcomes.
* Collaborate with a mission\-driven, passionate team.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive salary. Paid time off.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
* 401(k) with company match.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.

Pay: $74,000\.00 \- $104,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior EHR Support Analyst
jobs.description:
At Virginia Garcia Memorial Health Center, we honor all members of our community and acknowledge the dignity of each person we serve. Our purpose is to provide high quality, comprehensive primary health care to the communities of Washington and Yamhill counties with a special emphasis on migrant and seasonal farm workers and a view to removing barriers to health care. We strive to provide an environment that welcomes and values the people we employ and serve.


If you are unsure whether you meet all the required qualifications for this role but are interested and passionate about this potential position, we encourage you to apply.


Job Summary: The Senior EHR Support Analyst plans, analyzes, modifies, and optimizes Epic EHR as it relates to EpicCare, Wisdom, and Willow applications. The Senior EHR Support Analyst serves as the initial point of contact to support the EHR Support Analysts. In addition to the responsibilities listed below, this position is responsible for mentoring and providing technical support for more junior support team members and training newly hired EHR Support Analysts. This role assists with the evaluation and implementation of work transitioning to the Service Desk.
  

  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


* Delivers prompt end\-user customer support to VGMHC employees.
* Provides first and second level support to resolve problems with products and applications.
* Resolves complex problems and provides support to other EHR Support Analysts.
* Spearheads and executes process improvement projects to optimize operational efficiency.
* Fosters key stakeholder relationships, both internally and externally.
* Collaborates with other project managers, maintaining open lines of communication to ensure project success and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Conducts testing of new software implementations, upgrades, and fixes.
* Assumes ownership and accountability for the submission, monitoring, and tracking of Epic items using the JIRA reporting system and an internal Help Desk and Reporting system.
* Assists with efforts to analyze and prioritize incoming Solar Winds (Samanage) requests and alerts and help distribute as needed.
* Provides on\-site elbow support during the implementation of new software applications and system upgrades at each VG site, focusing on the Epic system.
* Collaborates closely with VG's training team to design and implement comprehensive training programs that enable users to leverage new functionality and upgrade rollouts effectively.
* Undertakes project management responsibilities for medium to large projects or sub\-projects.
* Develops comprehensive workflow maps (Visio) and training documentation that accurately captures and articulates changes.
* Conducts feasibility studies on office automation, including workflow analysis, space design considerations, and cost analysis to support informed decision\-making and improve operational efficiencies.
* Cultivates a collaborative and proactive approach with clinic leadership and users to identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, clinical practice support, and improved health outcomes.
* Employs advanced problem\-solving skills and industry knowledge to improve clinic operations and enhance patient care delivery.
* Escalates complex issues through appropriate leadership levels while ensuring effective communication with stakeholders.
* Monitors and tracks resolution of system error pools, such as refill, E\-prescribing, results, and order transmittal errors.
* Updates and maintains member\-managed system setups, including the provider master file, letter templates, Smart Phrases, and other service area files.
* Collaborates with staff to support service area preference lists and Smart Tools to troubleshoot and address user needs.
* Maintains partnership with OCHIN and advisory workgroups support effective implementation of new features and upgrades and to ensure successful adoption and utilization of enhanced functionalities.
* Participates in monthly OCHIN meetings to share best practices and updates.
* Represents EHR in workgroups, including Integration, Claims/Billing, Reporting, Clinical, and Operations.
* Conducts thorough evaluations of software solutions and recommends improvements or upgrades and reports findings to EHR Support Supervisor.
* Takes ownership of creating and maintaining Provider Epic user accounts, Provider Master Files (PMFs), Remote Access, LabCorp Link, Haiku/Canto, and Nuance Dragon Speak.
* Collaborates with VG Communications team to develop, schedule, and deploy CareMessage patient text message outreach.
* Assumes responsibility for creating and maintaining CareMessage user accounts.
* Works with OCHIN and VG Communications team to maintain and update VG MyChart website and application.
* Maintain updated Order Transmittal destination maps as needed.
* Reviews OCHIN alerts or notifications and service/enhancement packs and disseminates information to end users promptly.
* Maintains current knowledge of advancements and best practices in EHR systems, healthcare technology, and regulatory requirements. Participate in conferences, webinars, and advanced training sessions to continuously enhance knowledge and skills related to EHR support, showcasing a relentless pursuit of professional growth and excellence.
* Trains newly hired EHR Support Analysts.
* Follows procedures for incident escalation and notification to EHR Support Supervisor
* Performs other duties and projects as assigned.
* Handle protected health information (PHI) in a manner consistent with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA).

  

HIPAA Requirements:
  

The EHR Support Analyst will have access to PHI in the course of his/her duties. Applying the minimum necessary standard of HIPAA, the designated record sets to which this employee will have access include: all sections of the medical record, patient demographic information in the practice management system, and incoming records, reports, results, consultations, etc. The EHR Site Specialist is required to read the content of these records only to the extent needed to accomplish the assigned task.
  

  

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities required:
  

* Ability to troubleshoot and problem\-solve in a clinical or EHR setting.
* Knowledge of training and teaching strategies, methodologies, and basic instructional concepts.
* Ability to perform effective one\-on\-one and group training.
* Extensive knowledge of EPIC system (EHR and EDR).
* Knowledge of basic medical terminology preferred.
* Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint) and ability to demonstrate these skills.
* Excellent Customer Service skills.
* Planning and organizational skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, written and verbal.
* Ability to make independent decisions based on VGMHC policies and protocols.
* Bilingual English/Spanish language skills (speaking, reading, and writing) preferred.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* High degree of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism.
* Commitment and alignment to Virginia Garcia’s mission, vision, and values.
* Valid Oregon driver’s license, reliable transportation, safe driving record, and insurance coverage required.

  

Education and Experience:
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field required.
* Minimum three years’ EHR/IT Experience in a support or operations environment.
* OCHIN certification/proficiency required.
* EpicCare Ambulatory Certification required at or within twenty\-four months of hire.

jobs.title: EHR Application Analyst - Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** EHR (Electronic Health Records) Application Analyst \- Lead

**Department:** PFS Applications

**Location:** Hybrid (Onsite \& Remote); 100 Kings Highway South, Rochester, NY 14617

**Hours Per Week:** 40

**Schedule:** Typically, 8am \-4:30pm

 **SUMMARY:**  

The EHR Application Analyst Lead is the most senior individual contribution on the analyst team, serving as the primary subject matter expert for complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) system issues, configurations, and optimization. This role tackles the highest\-complexity work, holds multiple Epic certifications and serves as the top technical escalation resource for the team. The Application Analyst Lead also takes on coordination responsibilities – helping organize team workflows and supporting project management – while driving continuous improvement and sharing deep expertise across the organization.
  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

Lead System Support and Maintenance:
  

* Serve as the primary technical escalation resource for the most complex system issues, errors, and configuration, applying expert\-level, troubleshooting to drive resolution with minimal disruption to patient care.
* Work closely with operations to develop and coordinate issue resolution plans for high\-impact or cross\-team problems.
* Oversee and coordinate routine maintenance activities \- including software updates, patches, and upgrade \- ensuring stability and security standards are met.
* Coordinate and lead testing and validation activities for system changes, enhancements, and upgrades, following established change management processes.
* Participate in on\-call rotations, serving as the lead resource for complex or escalated after\-hours issues.

  

System Optimization and Continuous Improvement:
  

* Lead system optimization efforts, applying expert knowledge of EHR capabilities and healthcare workflows to identify inefficiencies and drive measurable improvement.
* Conduct advanced workflow assessments with operational partners to identify build opportunities and optimization needs.
* Advance optimization and enhancement requests through governance and change management channels; provide expert input on prioritization decisions.
* Apply cross\-application integration knowledge to ensure cohesive system performance and identify dependencies across modules.
* Contribute technical expertise to strategic planning discussions, informing roadmap direction and technology decisions.

  

Collaboration and Vendor Engagement:
  

* Coordinate work among team members on EHR projects, upgrades, and initiatives — tracking tasks, maintaining issue logs, facilitating meetings, and communicating status to project or team leads.
* Take on light project management responsibilities for defined initiatives, including maintaining project plans and coordinating timelines across stakeholders.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for EHR vendor relationships, managing open support requests, evaluating release notes for operational impact, and participating in user group sessions and advisory forums.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams — including IT, clinicians, administrators, and vendors — to support EHR initiatives and facilitate effective communication.

  

Documentation and Knowledge Management:  

* Maintain and own comprehensive documentation of complex system configurations, processes, and build decisions.
* Contribute to knowledge\-sharing practices that ensure critical information is accessible and current across the team.

  

Training and Mentorship:  

* Serve as a go\-to knowledge resource for junior and senior analysts, providing guidance on complex issues and sharing best practices.
* Support onboarding of new team members and contribute to informal training and skill\-building across the team.

  

Compliance and Data Privacy:
  

* Handle all protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations and organizational data privacy and security policies.
* Complete required compliance training and model information security best practices for the team.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**  

* Minimum of five (5\) years of experience as an EHR Application Analyst, Epic Application Analyst, Clinical Systems Analyst, or in a similar healthcare IT role supporting EHR implementation, optimization, and system support.

  

LICENSURE/CERTIFICATIONS:  

* Epic Certifications.
 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**  

* Excellent analytical, organization, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and serve as a technical resource for peers.
* Expert\-level ability to solve complex problems and translate operational needs into system solutions.
* Expert knowledge of healthcare business processes, workflows, and terminology.
* Cross\-application integration knowledge.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity tools.
* Basic project management skills, including ability to lead meetings, prioritize, resolve conflicts, maintain issue logs, manage timelines).
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, healthcare or related field.
